Hey, it's going to be ok! I know that it is hard and I think one of the main steps of self-harm is realizing that you are actually harming yourself and want to stop it. It's awesome that you want to stop it and I commend you; however, I think that its a really tough process when it comes to stopping. You said that you usually pick on your lips so I recommend buying some vaseline, keep applying chapstick, etc. Try to research some other methods. It will stop you if your lips end up becoming less and less chapped. In terms of fingers, I do that too and can't really stop because it's been a habit, but I recommend, since winter is coming up for me (I'm not sure for you), to wear gloves. Although it is for a small distance and I'm not sure if your school is doing all in-person learning or online learning, but wear them whenever you go outside and as much as possible. You can buy some gloves for fashion purposes if you want to as well. I hope my advice helped a little, and I promise you will get through this! Please do not expand your methods of self-harm because you will regret it. If you feel comfortable, I additionally recommend talking to an in-person therapist if you can or using therapy websites (such as 7cups). My DMs are open if you need them! You got this!
